author: TEDx Talks
description:
AI is rewriting coding, programming--and the way we learn it. Software developer and AI educator Rainer Stropek shares a personal turning point: the moment he questioned what he was teaching... and discovered he’d never enjoyed building software more than he does now, developing with AI.

From the grief many developers feel when "the fun part" seems automated, to a surprising rediscovery of creative agency, this talk reframes the shift: code isn’t the destination, it’s one abstraction layer.

What matters most is the skill that sits above syntax: turning fuzzy ideas into precise intent. If AI can generate functions in seconds, what still makes a great developer, and what should we teach next? The answer might be simpler (and harder) than you think: clarity.

Rainer Stropek helps teams build software with AI and teaches developers how to work across new abstraction layers.

description:
我們常以為，走向世界意味著變得更國際化、更專業、更接近主流標準。但當我真正進入紐約的品牌策略公司，與來自全球的企業決策者對話時，我才發現真正的挑戰不是融入世界，而是在巨大的聲音之中，仍然保有自己清晰的立場與視角。因為世界不缺聲音，缺的是不會被同化的觀點。 Kristine Liu is a brand strategist who helps organizations clarify who they are and how they show up in the world. She earned her master’s degree in Integrated Marketing Communications from Northwestern University and previously worked at Interbrand New York, contributing to global brand strategy work for organizations such as GE and Microsoft.

Now based in Taiwan as an independent consultant, Kristine brings international perspective to local brands seeking global relevance. She believes brands are a form of cultural language that’s shaped not just by strategy, but by lived experience, identity, and human insight. She also writes for Crossing, sharing reflections on branding, culture, and international careers. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.
title: 用世界的語言說出我們的故事 | Kristine Liu | TEDxNSYSU

author: TEDx Talks
description:
許多人認為國際交流是在拓展視野、累積見聞，讓自己更了解世界。但我認為，文化交流真正的價值不只是向外探索，而是在與世界建立連結的過程中，重新認識自己。從阿拉斯加打工度假，到不同國家的旅居與學習，再到與來自亞洲各地創作者共同合作，每一次跨文化的相遇都不只是認識他人，更是一場自我探索。當我們願意走進差異之中，世界不只是被看見的對象，也成為幫助我們理解自身價值與方向的一面鏡子。與世界連結，不只是為了看見更大的世界，而是為了在世界之中，看見更清晰的自己。

Through videos and writing, sharing personal stories and experiences discovered along the journey.
